name: Niqe
source:
A member of the Succubus tribe. She is Belbel's companion and friend. She is a gal-like succubus with short hair. 

She is one year older than Belbel and has a cheerful and blunt personality. She lives on Mt Sabato, where she creates medicines and dances on request.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/103kyonyu5/#character]official site[/url]]
